translations.ja: 君の笑顔はなんて美しいんだろう 君が歩けば誰もが目で追ってしまう 暗闇の日々から世界中を輝かせてくれる
translations.en: Your smile is so gorgeous, everyone looks at you, changing the whole world from a slightly dark day to bright.
translations.ko: 너의 미소는 너무나 아름다워, 누구나 너를 바라보고 어두웠던 세상을 환하게 바꿔
translations.zh-TW: 你的笑容是如此美麗，只要看著你，目光就會追隨，將整個昏暗的世界變成明亮
translations.id: Senyumanmu begitu indah, siapa pun yang melihatmu akan berpaling, mengubah seluruh dunia dari hari yang suram menjadi cerah
translations.pt: O teu sorriso é tão belo, basta olhar para ti e o mundo inteiro muda de um dia escuro para brilhante.

transcript.text: แววตาแค่มองก็ทำให้ใจละลายละมุนอ่อนหวาน

translations.en: Your eyes just by looking at them make my heart melt, so gentle and sweet.
translations.ko: 눈빛만 봐도 마음이 살르르 녹아내려 부드럽고 달콤하게
translations.zh-TW: 那眼神只需輕輕一望，就讓人心融化、溫柔甜美
translations.id: Sorot matanya saja sudah membuat hati meleleh, begitu lembut dan manis
translations.pt: Basta um olhar para derreter o coração, suave e doce.

translations.ja: 君を僕だけのものにしておきたいんだ 誰にも渡したくない 誰にも分け合いたくないんだ
translations.en: I want to keep you all to myself, I don't want to dress up for anyone, I don't want to share with anyone
translations.ko: 너를 나만의 것으로만 간직하고 싶어, 누구에게도 양보하고 싶지 않아
translations.zh-TW: 好想把你據為己有，不想讓你屬於任何人，不想跟任何人分享
translations.id: Ingin memilikimu untuk diriku sendiri, tidak ingin membiarkan siapa pun memilikimu, tidak ingin berbagi dengan siapa pun
translations.pt: Quero guardar-te apenas para mim, não quero que fiques com mais ninguém, não quero partilhar-te com ninguém.

translations.en: Be a little less cute, I don't want to think about you
translations.ko: 조금만 덜 귀여워져 줄래, 자꾸 네 생각이 나지 않도록
translations.zh-TW: 能不能可愛少一點，我不想一直想著你
translations.id: Kurangi sedikit kelucuanmu, aku tak ingin terus memikirkanmu
translations.pt: Sê um pouco menos fofa, não quero ter de pensar em ti
